newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Head of Venezuela tax superintendency resigns.
newsitem.headline: Head of Venezuela tax superintendency resigns.

text.p: The head of Venezuela's tax superintendency (Seniat) Edgar Paredes Pisani resigned Tuesday morning, Information Minister Fernando Egana said.
Egana did not give a reason for Paredes' resignation, but Seniat sources told Reuters that President Rafael Caldera had asked Paredes to leave the post which he had held since March last year.
The sources added Paredes Pisani had increasingly disagreed with Finance Minister Luis Raul Matos Azocar, to whom Seniat answers.
Paredes Pisani was formally head of the Planning Ministry, a post now occupied by the straight-talking Teodoro Petkoff, and prior to that head of Venezuela's Central Statistical Office, the OCEI.
Moraima Campos, currently Seniat Vice President, will take over operations until a new director is appointed, Egana told reporters.
In recent years, Seniat has successfully boosted tax collection so that tax revenues now account for some 40 percent of government revenues.
